cards.headline: Barça return to training with Koundé still working alone ahead of Alavés
cards.summary: Hansi Flick’s squad resumed sessions at the Ciutat Esportiva on Wednesday after two rest days. Jules Koundé continued individual work on his left ankle sprain and is the only injured player with a realistic chance of being available against Alavés on Saturday at 21:00. Six players remain out.
cards.body: The group trained under Flick at the Joan Gamper complex with the Alavés match at Spotify Camp Nou in mind. Koundé, who suffered the ankle injury against Betis, stayed separate from the collective work. Club and media reports listed the other absentees as Xavi Espart (syndesmosis, approximately seven weeks), Eric García, Andreas Christensen, Dani Olmo and Roony Bardghji. That leaves Cancelo, Balde, Cubarsí and Gerard Martín as the fully fit senior defenders. Pau Cubarsí, who skipped the Ballon d’Or gala with a fever, rejoined the full group and worked normally. Youth players Àlex Campos, Ebrima Tunkara and Hamza Abdelkarim trained with the first team, as they have in recent sessions. Flick’s side sit top of La Liga on 27 points after the 1-2 Clásico defeat and the midweek 4-2 loss to PSG. Alavés, seventh, have not won a league game since early September. MARCA and Mundo Deportivo confirmed Koundé’s continued absence from the group session and the presence of the three B-team players. The next two fixtures after Alavés are Aston Villa in the Champions League and Atlético at home.

cards.headline: RFEF fines Barça €602 for minor breach over Julián Álvarez approach
cards.summary: The Spanish FA’s disciplinary committee fined Barcelona 602 euros after Atlético Madrid complained about contact with Julián Álvarez while he was under contract. The sanction falls under Article 133 as a light infringement. Barça can appeal within ten days.
cards.body: Atlético reported the club to both the RFEF and FIFA in late June. FIFA said it had no jurisdiction. The committee found a conversation took place between Álvarez’s then agent Fernando Hidalgo and Deco on 15 May, with the first written notice to Atlético arriving on 28 May. It judged the case a minor regulatory breach rather than a serious one under Article 93. The maximum fine under the relevant clause is 602 euros. Álvarez remains at Atlético until June 2030. He scored against Deportivo last weekend and apologised to supporters after comments during the World Cup about wanting to play for Barcelona. Reuters, BBC Sport and Spanish agencies carried the ruling. The club offered around 100 million euros in the summer without success. Atlético’s CEO Miguel Ángel Gil Marín had insisted they would not sell to a domestic rival. The file is closed subject to any appeal by Barcelona.

cards.headline: Club publishes international viewing guide for Saturday’s Alavés match
cards.summary: FC Barcelona released the kick-off times and broadcasters for the La Liga fixture against Alavés at Spotify Camp Nou on 31 October at 21:00 local time. The side wants a response after consecutive defeats. Alavés sit seventh and have gone without a league win since 6 September.
cards.body: The official Spanish and English channels posted the guide. In Spain the match is on Movistar. UK viewers have Disney+ and Premier Sports; the United States has ESPN platforms; Latin America uses Sky, IZZI and ESPN. The club site and app will carry the live blog, and Barça Live is available on YouTube and Barça Play. Kick-off is 21:00 CET / 20:00 UK. The post from the Spanish account directed fans to the full list of territories. After the Clásico loss and the PSG defeat, Flick’s side remain first on 27 points. The next Champions League game is against Aston Villa. Official accounts updated the fixture details on Wednesday.

cards.headline: Only four senior defenders available as youth players train with the group
cards.summary: With Espart, Eric García, Christensen and Koundé unavailable or limited, Flick has Cancelo, Balde, Cubarsí and Gerard Martín fit. Àlex Campos, Ebrima Tunkara and Hamza Abdelkarim joined the first-team session on Wednesday. Koundé remains the only injury with a possible return for Saturday.
cards.body: Espart’s syndesmosis injury, confirmed after the Clásico, rules him out for roughly seven weeks. Eric García and Christensen continue recovery from earlier issues, and Olmo and Bardghji are also sidelined. Campos, who was in the squad for PSG and the Clásico, trained with the seniors again. Tunkara and Hamza have been regular additions in recent weeks. Mundo Deportivo noted Cubarsí’s return after his fever. The club’s medical staff will assess Koundé’s ankle over the next 48 hours before naming the Alavés squad. Barça have already used multiple defensive combinations this season. The match is the first of three in quick succession before the international break.

cards.headline: Cubarsí back in full group training after fever kept him from Ballon d’Or gala
cards.summary: Pau Cubarsí trained normally with the squad on Wednesday after missing the London ceremony with a fever. The centre-back is available for Alavés while the defensive options remain thin. He worked alongside the rest of the group at the Ciutat Esportiva.
cards.body: Cubarsí chose not to travel to the Ballon d’Or event on Monday while recovering. Wednesday’s session was his first full group work since. Mundo Deportivo reported he completed the session without restriction. With Espart out for seven weeks and Koundé still separate, Cubarsí and Gerard Martín are the only two fully fit senior centre-backs. Cancelo and Balde provide the full-back options. The 19-year-old has started regularly this season. The club posted training footage on its official accounts. His return is one of the few positive notes from the midweek session after the two defeats.

cards.headline: Official accounts post training clips as the squad prepares for Saturday
cards.summary: FC Barcelona shared video of the Wednesday session and of Joan Garcia working in goal. The Spanish account posted a clip focused on the Alavés match. The side is seeking a reaction at home after the Clásico and PSG results.
cards.body: The English account’s post “Welcome back to training, lads” carried video from the Ciutat Esportiva. A later Spanish post showed Garcia in training. Another official clip directed fans to the viewing times for the Saturday fixture. The content appeared after the two-day break that followed the 1-2 defeat to Real Madrid. Flick’s group remains top of the table. Alavés visit on 31 October at 21:00. The posts received tens of thousands of views within hours. Club channels continue to update the injury picture around Koundé ahead of the squad announcement.

cards.headline: MARCA reports team meal as Barça look to turn the page on two defeats
cards.summary: MARCA described a communal meal after Wednesday’s session as the squad prepared for Alavés. The report noted the desire to move on from the losses to PSG and Real Madrid. Koundé remained outside the group work.
cards.body: The paper’s piece said the players shared a meal after training at the Ciutat Esportiva. The session was the first collective work since the Clásico. Six players are still unavailable or restricted. The article pointed to the need for a response at Camp Nou on Saturday. Alavés have not won in the league since 6 September and sit seventh. Barça lead on 27 points. The next Champions League fixture is against Aston Villa on 3 November. Official channels focused on the return to work and the fixture details rather than the meal itself.

cards.headline: Espart’s seven-week absence confirmed as Balde expected to start at left-back
cards.summary: The club’s medical report after the Clásico listed Xavi Espart out for approximately seven weeks with a syndesmosis injury. He left the match at half-time. Alejandro Balde is the immediate replacement on the left.
cards.body: Espart felt the problem early against Real Madrid after a collision and was replaced by Balde. Tests confirmed the syndesmosis damage. The timeline takes him out of the next three matches and into the international break. He had signed a contract extension until 2030 only days earlier and scored on his full Champions League debut against PSG. With Koundé still limited, the right-back role is also open. Cancelo can cover either side. The official accounts posted the medical bulletin on Monday. Media in Spain noted the already thin defensive list. Balde has had limited minutes this season but is now first choice on the left for Alavés.
